name: Night chapter looks and lamps
body: Rework games/platformer/settings/chapter-looks.nyx and the per-level lamps so each chapter is a night: dark sky, a dim moon-style key light, cool ambient, fog tuned, with the companion, lantern, checkpoint posts, goal and gems as the light you see. Keep platform edges and thorns readable. Keep the day look as a `look` option (LANTERN_LOOK=day). Check frame time.

comments.text: Done: built and checked in a cloud session (lavapipe screenshots, mist run test 216/216). Frame time not measured on a real GPU.

acceptance_criteria: Each chapter reads as night in a screenshot
